title: PROMETHEUS — NASA PSI Provenance-Tracked Combustion Seed Corpus
description: A small, provenance-preserving seed corpus built from NASA Physical Sciences Informatics investigation metadata and experimental-table entries. It is not a substitute for the full PSI download; missing values remain missing.

sources.title: NASA PSI-98 — Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment-I (SAFFIRE-I)
sources.citation: NASA Physical Sciences Informatics, PSI-98 Version 4, Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment-I (SAFFIRE-I). DOI: 10.60555/0t15-1z43.
sources.note: NASA experimental table values. O2 midpoint and microgravity proxy are explicitly documented as canonicalization aids; the source reports an O2 range and low-g regime.

sources.title: NASA PSI-69 — Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX)
sources.citation: NASA Physical Sciences Informatics, PSI-69 Version 5, Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX). DOI: 10.60555/mbq8-0451.
sources.note: NASA investigation metadata. Documents LOI studies, droplet burning/extinction, 0.5–1.5 atm test pressure range and ~3 mm droplets.

sources.title: NASA PSI-25 — Burning and Suppression of Solids-II (BASS-II)
sources.citation: NASA Physical Sciences Informatics, PSI-25 Version 4, Burning and Suppression of Solids-II (BASS-II). DOI: 10.60555/4qc4-de67.
sources.note: NASA investigation metadata. Documents ignition, flame growth, flame spread and extinction limits for solid fuels in microgravity.

sources.title: NASA PSI-107 — Smoke Point In Co-flow Experiment (SPICE)
sources.citation: NASA Physical Sciences Informatics, PSI-107 Version 4, Smoke Point In Co-flow Experiment (SPICE). DOI: 10.60555/9kbh-e962.
sources.note: NASA investigation metadata. Documents 526 flames, methane/ethylene/propane/propylene fuels, 0.41/0.76/1.6 mm burners and 5.4–65 cm/s co-flow velocities.

sources.title: NASA PSI-62 — Concurrent Flame Spread Modeling in Microgravity
sources.citation: NASA Physical Sciences Informatics, PSI-62 Version 1, Concurrent Flame Spread Modeling using Flamelet Generated Manifolds in Microgravity with Comparison to BASS Experiments using Two-Color Tomography. DOI: 10.60555/e9xp-ex83.
sources.note: NASA PSI ground investigation using BASS/BASS-II imagery and modeling; included to connect experiment evidence with validated modeling research.

experiments.text: NASA PSI-98 experimental-table record. Sample S1; SIBAL fabric 0.37 cm thick, 40.6 cm long, 94 cm wide; air flow 20 cm/s; O2 21.5–21.7%; ignition power 182 W; ignition time 8 s; burn time 420 s; flow direction Concurrent. Canonical O2 is a midpoint only; gravity is a visualization proxy for the reported microgravity regime.

observations.description: SPICE studies smoke-point / sooting propensity for methane under non-buoyant jet diffusion flame conditions.
